nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the @hive-mind/claude-code-hooks package, describing the four lifecycle hooks (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, PreCompact) that silently capture Claude Code session memory into the local hive-mind substrate via the shim-core CLI bridge. Covers installation, Windows path pinning, reversibility via SHA-256-verified backup, and MEMORY.md coexistence.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @hive-mind/claude-code-hooks, a Wave 1 MVP pre-1.0 OSS package that patches ~/.claude/settings.json with four hook entries to route Claude Code lifecycle events into the hive-mind memory substrate. Declares a bin entry point, ESM exports, and a peer dependency on @hive-mind/cli.
